howto.what: 当 execute_code_sandbox 连续失败2次后，Claude 会改用 write_file 将 Python 代码保存为 .py 文件，再用 run_shell 执行该脚本，从而绕过沙箱问题。
howto.when: 当 execute_code_sandbox 连续失败2次以上，且错误原因不明或持续存在时触发。

say.text: 先帮我写一个Python脚本保存成文件，然后运行它。
用文件执行方式重试刚才的Python代码，别用sandbox了。

say.note: 完整fallback流程：写、执行、读结果。

howto.what_en: When execute_code_sandbox fails twice consecutively, Claude will revert to writing Python code to a .py file using write_file, then executing it via run_shell command line, bypassing sandbox issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when execute_code_sandbox fails 2+ times in a row with unknown, persistent, or unexplained errors.

say_en.text: Write a Python script to a file and then run it.
say_en.note: Claude uses write_file and run_shell instead of sandbox.

say_en.text: Retry the Python code using file execution, not sandbox.
Save this code to a file, execute, then read the output file.
say_en.note: Full fallback: write, execute, read results.
